A SIMPLE LISTENING GUIDE

Dreamscape on your iPhone

  1. Open the Dreamscape link in Safari and sign in to the account that owns this private preview.
  2. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open Dreamscape from its new icon.
  3. Choose a soundscape or story, tap Your mix, and set your volume and timer.
  4. For a lock-screen test, enable Prepare a session for the lock screen, choose a timer, and press Play. Wait for preparation before locking the screen.

What to test

Use a 5-minute timer. Listen for one minute with the screen unlocked, then lock it for at least five minutes. Confirm uninterrupted audio, a gradual fade in the final minute, and silence when the timer ends. Repeat from Safari and from the Home Screen, including pause/resume on the lock screen and a headphone interruption.

Current limitations

Actual iOS lock-screen playback has not been tested. Safari can suspend audio processing and background page timers. Live mixing may stop or fade late. Prepared sessions put the fade in the audio itself; iOS can still interrupt or terminate playback.

A native iPhone app can use Apple’s background audio mode and AVAudioSession for more dependable playback, interruption handling, and mixing. It requires native development, device testing, and Apple distribution setup.

Offline & privacy

The interface and original soundscapes are cached after the first successful online visit. Private hosting may still require an online sign-in. Narrator uploads and preferences are stored only in this browser; clearing website data removes them.

Five story concepts are included. The Rainy Cabin is a comparison script; the other four are short drafts. Full 30–45 minute narrated stories and the two ElevenLabs samples remain unfinished.
